content.value_statement: ModelArts resources span many services and operational workflows. This skill provides a documented routing map for selecting the relevant service area.
actual_capabilities: Maps ModelArts task keywords to documented service areas.
Lists notebook, training, inference, and resource pool operations.
Describes notebook and environment-variable authentication modes.
Catalogs OBS, SWR, VPC, KMS, and Lite Server integrations.
Summarizes node pool, plugin, workspace, quota, and authorization workflows.
limitations: The package contains no executable ModelArts integration code.
Every linked reference document is absent from the audited package.
Credential isolation claims cannot be verified from the included files.
Cloud operations, permissions, API behavior, and responses cannot be tested.

use_cases.title: Plan Notebook Operations
use_cases.description: Identify the documented area for notebook lifecycle, images, flavors, authentication, and OBS storage.

use_cases.title: Map Training and Inference Tasks
use_cases.description: Separate training workflows from versioned inference service operations before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Platform Administration Scope
use_cases.description: Survey resource pools, node pools, workspaces, quotas, networking, keypairs, and Lite Server operations.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Service Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Which documented ModelArts service area covers [task]? State the relevant module and the package limitation.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline the documented workflow areas for [goal]. Separate available documentation from missing implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Inference Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the documented ModelArts inference v1 and v2 capabilities for [service need]. Identify unanswered implementation questions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an Operations Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ModelArts operations plan: [plan]. Map each step to a documented module, flag destructive actions, and identify missing verification.

output_examples.input: Where should I look for scaling a node group?
output_examples.output: Use the documented node pool area for scaling node pools. The referenced node pool guide is not included in this package.

output_examples.input: Which areas cover a new online inference service and its network?
output: Use the inference v2 area for the newer online service workflow.
Use the VPC area for virtual networks, subnets, and security groups.
Verify all steps externally because the referenced guides and implementation are absent.

best_practices: Verify required Huawei Cloud permissions before planning any operation.
Treat create, delete, stop, scale, and authorization changes as confirmation-required actions.
Validate all guidance against current Huawei Cloud documentation and available implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the listed modules or reference files are included.
Do not expose access keys, secret keys, or security tokens in prompts.
Do not execute destructive cloud changes from this documentation alone.

faq.question: Does this package execute ModelArts operations?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains documentation only and includes no executable integration.

faq.question: Which ModelArts areas are documented?
faq.answer: It catalogs notebooks, pools, training, inference, administration, storage, networking, keys, images, and Lite Server operations.

faq.question: Are the linked reference guides included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md and README.md.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: The document describes notebook detection and local environment variables, but no authentication implementation is included.

faq.question: Can I rely on the credential protection claim?
faq.answer: No. Verify credential isolation independently because the cited authentication code is absent.

faq.question: Does it support inference v1 and v2?
faq.answer: The document lists both versions, but their referenced guides and implementation are not included.
